forwarding.how: Each review email you forward becomes a review here. A poor one goes on your Watching screen the day it comes in, and into your weekly summary. Mail from anyone but a review site is ignored.

google.label: Google Business Profile
google.notSetUpTitle: Reading from Google isn't set up yet
google.manage: Manage or revoke it on Connections
google.connected: SYB reads your reviews once a day and files new ones here, alongside any you forward. The same review arriving both ways is listed once.
google.whatItCanDo: Google's permission can also post replies to your reviews and edit your Business Profile listing. SYB only reads your reviews with it. You can revoke it any time.
google.notSetUp: Not set up yet. Google lets apps read Business Profile reviews only after it approves them, and SYB's approval isn't in place yet. Until then, forward Google's review emails or paste a review.

needs.approval: SYB's approval from Google to use the Business Profile APIs (Google's own review of SYB).
needs.signIn: You sign in with the Google account that manages your Business Profile, and allow the one permission Google asks about.
needs.location: If you manage more than one location, you pick the one SYB reads.

google.readNote: Read from your Google Business Profile.
